items.meta_description: Install VpnHood! CLIENT on Linux with one command, connect from its window or the command line, start it at boot, and run it on a machine with no desktop.
items.title: Install VpnHood! CLIENT on Linux
items.lead: One command installs the app, with a window on a desktop and a set of commands everywhere, so it also runs on a machine with no screen.
items.before_need: An access key from whoever runs the server, as VpnHood! CLIENT has no servers of its own.
items.connect_desktop: On a desktop, open [app] from the application menu, add your access key and connect.
items.connect_terminal: From a terminal, or on a machine with no desktop, add your access key, connect, and check the connection:
items.connect_note: [cmd] profile add also takes the path of a file holding the key. With several profiles, choose the one to connect with: [cmd] profile set-default.
items.cmd_profile_list: Lists your profiles, and marks the one that connects.
items.cmd_profile_add: Adds a profile from an access key, or from a file holding one.
